meta.name: Hostel Daze
meta.description: Four naive and vulnerable wing-mates develop lasting bonds as they jostle hard to survive the first semester in a hostel. Peppered with absurdities, chutzpahs, clashes and debacles inherent to hostel life, 'Hostel Daze' depicts the grill that every Indian hostel-resident goes through.

videos.title: Intro
videos.overview: Ankit Pandey enters hostel to ﬁnd that the room allotted to him is already occupied by Chirag and Jaat. He has to ﬁnd himself a room, and a bed that too in the ragging period.

videos.title: Proving Identity
videos.overview: Ankit grapples with identity crisis as he ﬁnds himself pretty ordinary amongst his batch-mates.

videos.title: F.O.S.L.A
videos.overview: Ankit is smitten by Akanksha, the most prized catch of not only his batch but entire college. Will a coy Ankit succeed?

videos.title: GPL
videos.overview: Ankit tries to hide his birthday from his wing-mates to avoid the dreaded GPL. Will he succeed?

videos.title: End Sem
videos.overview: With Chirag suddenly gone unavailable at the last moment, Ankit and Jhantoo have to survive the end-sems.

videos.title: D.I.S.C.O
videos.overview: The gang is a year older and realises their authoritative role as seniors not realising that “breaking ice” with the juniors could land them into trouble.

videos.title: Love-Square
videos.overview: We have all been through love triangles. But when Jaat and Jhantoo end up falling for the same girl a love square is formed. With Ankit and Chirag as catalysts, both pursue Unnati, the heartthrob of the hostel.

videos.title: Gandagi
videos.overview: Ankit does everything in his power to woo Akanksha by showing her how clean he is in a typical dirty boys hostel. Akanksha however doesn’t seem impressed leaving Ankit heartbroken.

videos.title: Ghar Wapsi
videos.overview: The gang is all prepared to leave for their homes during the break except for Jhantoo who must stay back. Through the course of the days the boys discover if home is the place to stay or hostel, the place to be.

videos.title: Failed Experiments
videos.overview: In order to make their lives exciting in third year, the group put themselves through a series of experiments.

videos.title: Wing Chor
videos.overview: Chirag turns detective to find a notorious thief in the hostel, meanwhile someone spills Akanksha’s secrets to her mother.

videos.title: Lights Camera Cut
videos.overview: The team led by Chirag, gears up to make a short film in order to win the inter-hostel competition.

videos.title: Dosti Ka Udhar
videos.overview: The group gets divided as a dispute ensues between two friends messing up their friendship.

videos.title: G.S.H.A
videos.overview: Jhantoo contests election against a worthy opponent for the post of General Secretary of Hostel Affairs.

videos.title: Dear Seniors
videos.overview: As the year ends, the group prepares to bid a final goodbye to their seniors, also introspecting their own relationships.

videos.title: Single Room
videos.overview: As the seniors are allotted single rooms in the hostel, the gang refuses to get serious about their final year until reality hits them in the form of an unexpected event.

videos.title: Curriculum Vitae
videos.overview: Ankit struggles to write his CV while Chirag and Nabomita have a difficult time keeping their relationship a secret.

videos.title: Compromise
videos.overview: Jhantu tries to focus on his placements preparation but ends up getting involved in a hostel fight

videos.title: Day Zero
videos.overview: Day Zero of placement is here and its a testing time for the group.

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: Tensions rise high as the placement season is in it’s full swing and the gang must give it all to leave the hostel with a job in hand.

videos.title: Hostel Departure
videos.overview: It's the end of a journey where everyone gets to say their final goodbyes to their beloved hostel. But each person does it in their own way.
